answer_text:
Use the volume-weighted average:

\[
\text{Average density}=\frac{\sum (V_i \rho_i)}{\sum V_i}
\]

Given:
- \(80\) bbl at \(10.1\) ppg
- \(120\) bbl at \(10.7\) ppg
- \(100\) bbl at \(11.2\) ppg

Compute total mass-equivalent:

\[
80(10.1)=808
\]
\[
120(10.7)=1284
\]
\[
100(11.2)=1120
\]

Sum:

\[
808+1284+1120=3212
\]

Total volume:

\[
80+120+100=300 \text{ bbl}
\]

Average density:

\[
\frac{3212}{300}=10.7067 \text{ ppg}
\]

**Answer: 10.71 ppg**
